an1.140:1.1: This chapter presents the “ten roots of dispute” as in [an10.42](). | This section deals with technicalities of Vinaya. This emphasis suggests that these portions, and perhaps the Book of the Ones as a whole, was designed as a primer for newly-ordained monastics. If so, it would follow on from the Khuddakapāṭha (“Basic Passages”, Kp 1), which was a textbook for novices.
